newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jail sought for youth with anti-police t-shirt.
newsitem.headline: Jail sought for youth with anti-police t-shirt.

text.p: A public prosecutor has sought a jail term against a teenager arrested on a suburban train wearing a tee-shirt bearing the English words "Fuck the police", French radio said on Friday.
The youth, whose name was not given because he is a minor, faces a possible six-month sentence for insults against official representatives of the law, Radio France Info said.

But the public prosecutor in Melun, a rough area outside Paris, was reported to have asked the court to add the charge of threatening sexual attacks against official representatives of the law, which carries a possible two-year sentence.
The youth was arrested by outraged policemen at about the same time that an off-duty policewoman was attacked, gang-raped and slashed by a group of five youths late at night on a suburban train.
Two singers for a French rap band were given three-month jail terms in November and banned from performing for six months for using song lyrics attacking the police.

The singers, who are highly popular in poor suburbs where youths and police are often at loggerheads, were members of a rap group called NTM. The initials stand for "Nique Ta Mere" (Fuck Your Mother).
